en.name: Bresaola
en.summary: Bresaola is beef topside salted and air-dried for a couple of months — very lean, deep red, and usually eaten raw in paper-thin slices. A whole piece or an unopened vacuum pack keeps about 2–3 months refrigerated; once it is opened or sliced, that drops to 3–5 days. No agency publishes a bresaola timeline, so treat these as working limits borrowed from prosciutto and pre-packaged salami rather than as documented figures.
en.pantry: There is no room-temperature timeline for bresaola here, and that is deliberate. Unlike a whole dry-cured leg, bresaola is usually sold already cut or vacuum-packed, and a cut face on a lean muscle simply dries and darkens at room temperature. Keep it refrigerated, and take slices out 10–15 minutes before serving so they are not eaten fridge-cold — that is the only time it should be out.
en.fridge: Keep bresaola at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. A whole piece or an unopened vacuum pack runs about 2–3 months from purchase, or to its printed date, wrapped in paper rather than plastic. Once you open the pack or have it sliced at the counter it becomes an opened ready-to-eat meat with 3–5 days in it: keep the slices stacked and touching, wrapped airtight, and eat them soon. Grey-brown edges mean oxidation; deep red is what you want. Dress it at the table, not in the fridge — oil and lemon will keep working on it and turn it grey. Because it is very lean it does not go rancid the way coppa does; left too long a whole piece just keeps drying until it is hard and dark.
en.freezer: A working limit of 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and honestly it is not recommended for anything you want to serve as carpaccio. Lean and paper-thin is exactly what freezer burn ruins: the slices thaw dry and papery. If you must, interleave them with baking paper, bag them flat and press the air out, then use them cooked or folded into something warm.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, still wrapped, and use the slices the same day. Never thaw on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: Slices gone grey-brown right through rather than red with dry edges.
A sour, sharp or fermented smell instead of a clean beefy, faintly winey one.
Anything slimy or tacky on the surface of opened slices.
Fuzzy green, grey or black mould on a cut face — discard the piece rather than trimming it.
tips: Buy a piece rather than a packet if you eat it slowly; slices are on a three-to-five-day clock.
Write the opening date on the pack — this is the number people get wrong.
Wrap opened slices with the faces touching so less surface meets the air.
Slice it as thin as you can and let it sit on the plate a few minutes before eating.

faq.q: How long does bresaola keep once the pack is opened?
faq.a: Treat it like any opened sliced cured meat: 3–5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped airtight. This is a working limit, not a published one.
You can, for a month or two, but it is a poor idea for eating raw — the thin lean slices go dry and papery.

faq.q: Does bresaola need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes. Whether it is a whole piece or a pack of slices, keep it at 4 °C or below; only bring it out to come up to temperature before serving.

It falls into the dried, salted cured meats rather than the moist deli meats, which is the safer of the two classes — but a pack of thin slices is a wetter surface than the whole muscle it came from, and heating it through remains the cautious option.

zh.name: 義式風乾牛肉
zh.summary: 義式風乾牛肉（bresaola）是牛後腿內側肉鹽漬後風乾兩個月左右的產品，極瘦、色深紅，通常切成薄如紙的生片食用。整塊或未開封真空包冷藏大約 2～3 個月；一旦開封或切片，就只剩 3～5 天。目前沒有任何機構公布過它的保存期限，這些數字是比照生火腿（prosciutto）和預先包裝的莎樂美腸推得的工作參考值，不是有出處的定論。
zh.pantry: 這份資料刻意不給它常溫期限。和整支風乾後腿不同，風乾牛肉多半是已經切片或真空包裝販售，而瘦肉的切面在常溫下就是一路變乾變黑。請一律冷藏，只在上桌前 10～15 分鐘把切片拿出來回溫——那是它唯一該離開冰箱的時候。
zh.fridge: 請放 4 °C 以下。整塊或未開封真空包，從購買日起算約 2～3 個月，或以包裝標示日期為準，用紙包而不要用塑膠袋悶著。一旦拆封、或請店家現切，它就是一份「已開封的即食肉品」，只剩 3～5 天：把切片疊在一起、面貼著面密封包好，盡快吃完。邊緣轉灰褐代表氧化，深紅色才是你要的。調味請在餐桌上做，不要先拌好放冰箱——油和檸檬會繼續「熟成」它，把顏色逼成灰色。因為它太瘦，不像卡波克洛那樣會出現油耗；整塊放太久只是愈來愈硬、愈來愈深色。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下的工作參考值是 1～2 個月，但老實說，要當生食冷肉吃的話不建議冷凍。又瘦又薄正是凍傷最容易毀掉的組合，解凍後乾得像紙。真要冷凍，請用烘焙紙一片片隔開、平放裝袋壓出空氣，並把它用在加熱的料理裡，不要端上冷盤。
zh.thawing: 維持包裝放冷藏解凍，並在當天用完。不要放室溫退冰，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 整片變成灰褐色，而不是紅肉配乾燥的邊。
聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有發酵味，而不是乾淨的牛肉香帶點酒香。
開封切片表面發黏、摸起來黏手。
切面出現綠、灰或黑色絨毛霉——整塊丟棄，不要只削掉那一塊。
tips: 吃得慢就買整塊，不要買切片包；切片只有三到五天。
在包裝上寫開封日期——這是最多人算錯的數字。
開封後把切片面對面疊好再包，接觸空氣的面積才會少。
盡量切薄，上桌後靜置幾分鐘再吃。

faq.q: 風乾牛肉開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 比照其他已開封的切片醃肉：4 °C 以下、密封包好，3～5 天。這是工作參考值，不是官方公布的數字。
可以放一兩個月，但要生食的話不划算——薄而瘦的切片解凍後又乾又柴。
需要。不論整塊還是切片包，都放 4 °C 以下；只在上桌前拿出來回溫。

faq.q: 孕婦可以吃風乾牛肉嗎？
faq.a: 它屬於「乾燥鹽漬」而非「濕潤即食冷肉」，是兩類當中相對安全的那一類；但一包薄切片的表面比它原本那塊整肉濕得多，最保險的做法仍然是加熱到全熱再吃。
